prDescription: Add local search and status filters to the organizer's registration list. Search covers the name on the registration and the participant's account name. The filters affect visible rows; workshop capacity and status totals still describe the whole workshop. The organizer can reset both filters. Switching workshop starts with an unfiltered list; refreshing the same workshop or returning from the existing participant preview should retain the current filters while loading current registration data. Existing confirmation, cancellation, pending feedback, unknown-outcome handling, and preview permissions remain in scope.
